name: gesture-left-local
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached native crop of a clothed dealer. Hot magenta marks an occluding hand and single playing card that have been removed. Inpaint ONLY magenta with the CLOTHING hidden beneath. Preserve the exact crop borders, camera, size, and every non-magenta fragment. Connect each visible piece of waistcoat, gold lapel trim, cream shirt, red embroidery and cloak through the missing area so they form one continuous costume. The existing gold lines must meet precisely at both sides of each missing patch. Do not invent a new lapel or alter the shape of the clothing. Full fidelity to the untouched non-magenta islands between the original fingers, including their black cel-shadows. Near the cuff use dark sleeve lining, matching the original garment. No hand, arm, cards, deck, rectangular border, pocket, outline along the magenta mask or new embellishments. Broad flat colours, ink contours and cel shading exactly as adjacent funeral-print art. Fill all magenta; preserve original transparent areas. No text. Output exactly the same registered crop.
